event_before.name: Dubai Future Week 2026
event_before.description: Four-day Dubai Future Foundation event at Emirates Towers and the Museum of the Future, with talks, university research prototypes, exhibitions and sessions about cities, AI, learning, technology, wellbeing and economies. Registration is offered for the wider week. The separate 500 Future Minds session on November 21 (8:30 a.m.–1 p.m.) invites applications from 500 Dubai-based professionals across education, health response, architecture and urban planning, finance and entrepreneurship; participation requires approval.

event_after.name: Dubai Future Week 2026
event_after.description: Dubai Future Foundation gathering at Emirates Towers and the Museum of the Future, combining foresight, university prototypes, public experiences and the inaugural Science, Technology, Arts, and Research Summit (STARS). Registration is offered for the wider week; individual sessions may be public or invitation-only. The separate 500 Future Minds workshop on November 21, 8:30 a.m.-1 p.m. Dubai time, requires approval and Dubai-based professional eligibility. Its published selection-decision date was November 1; late application availability is unconfirmed. General registration does not establish access to restricted sessions. Prices, livestreams and recordings were not confirmed. A mixed public and professional program, not a peer-reviewed conference.
event_after.source: Official Dubai Future Week homepage, programme, STARS, 500 Future Minds and event terms inspected November 12, 2026. https://www.dubaifutureweek.com/en/programme; https://www.dubaifutureweek.com/en/concepts/stars; https://www.dubaifutureweek.com/en/500-future-minds; https://www.dubaifutureweek.com/en/event-terms . Date and venue also corroborated by Dubai Government Media Office September 1 announcement. No cancellation or postponement notice found in the inspected official material; announced schedule is not proof of future occurrence. No forms submitted, admission inventory tested or blanket reuse permission inferred.
